source_assertions.title: Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events
source_assertions.raw_file: horary_knowledge/Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events (Barbara H. Watters) (Z-Library).txt
source_assertions.claim: Watters says Mars was retrograde from January 21 to April 12, 1933, that Hitler came to power on January 30, and that he eventually was defeated on all fronts and died in the holocaust.
